editorial.text: Keep a representative for each component and merge representatives when an edge is inserted.

statement.text: There are n fixed vertices. Add undirected edges and answer whether two vertices are connected. There are no deletions.

editorial.text: The predicate a[i] >= x is false before a boundary and true from that boundary onward.

statement.text: Given a nondecreasing array a and value x, find the first index i with a[i] >= x, or report none.
